IIT Delhi Announces Special PhD Admissions for SC/ST Candidates

IIT Delhi has launched a special admission drive for PhD programs in 2026, specifically targeting Scheduled Caste (SC) and Scheduled Tribe (ST) candidates. The drive aims to increase representation from these communities. Key dates and the seat matrix are available for interested applicants.
